import re

def parse(lines):
    mod = {}
    modl = []
    funcs = []
    fl = []
    data = []
    dl = []
    texts = {}
    order = []
    tl = []
    skip = []
    sec = None
    kvsecs = ('NAME', 'FILE', 'MODULE REFERENCE', 'VERSION', 'AUTHOR', 'CREDITS', 'DATE')
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        s = l.strip()
        ind = len(l) - len(l.lstrip())
        m = re.match(r'^Help on (.+?) (\S+?):\s*$', l)
        if m and sec is None:
            mod['kind'] = m.group(1)
            mod['module'] = m.group(2)
            modl.append(i)
            continue
        if ind == 0 and re.match(r'^[A-Z][A-Z ]*[A-Z]$', s):
            sec = s
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'NAME':
            if 'name' not in mod:
                m = re.match(r'^(\S+)(?:\s+-\s+(.*))?$', s)
                mod['name'] = m.group(1)
                mod['summary'] = m.group(2) or ''
            else:
                mod['summary'] = (mod['summary'] + ' ' + s).strip()
            modl.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'MODULE REFERENCE' and 'reference' not in mod and re.match(r'^\S+://\S+$', s):
            mod['reference'] = s
            modl.append(i)
            continue
        if sec in kvsecs and sec != 'MODULE REFERENCE':
            k = sec.lower()
            mod[k] = (mod.get(k, '') + ' ' + s).strip()
            modl.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'FUNCTIONS':
            if ind <= 4 or not funcs:
                m = re.match(r'^([^\s(]+)(.*)$', s)
                funcs.append({'name': m.group(1), 'signature': m.group(2).strip(), 'doc': ''})
            else:
                funcs[-1]['doc'] = (funcs[-1]['doc'] + ' ' + s).strip()
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        if sec == 'DATA':
            m = re.match(r'^(\S+) = (.*)$', s)
            if m and (ind <= 4 or not data):
                data.append({'name': m.group(1), 'value': m.group(2)})
                dl.append(i)
                continue
            if data:
                data[-1]['value'] = data[-1]['value'] + ' ' + s
                dl.append(i)
                continue
        key = sec or 'PREAMBLE'
        if key not in texts:
            texts[key] = []
            order.append(key)
        texts[key].append(s)
        tl.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if modl:
        blocks.append({'name': 'module', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': modl, 'records': [mod]})
    if funcs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'functions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': funcs})
    if data:
        blocks.append({'name': 'data', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': dl, 'records': data})
    if tl:
        blocks.append({'name': 'sections', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tl, 'records': [{'section': k, 'text': '\n'.join(texts[k])} for k in order]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
